description: Tool contracts for a local MCP/LLM advisor consuming ForeverAddonDB.exportJson. The addon makes no network calls.

tools.name: market_health
tools.description: Return freshness, coverage and anomalies. Always include confidence and missing-data flags.

tools.name: top_flips
tools.description: Rank flips by profit/ROI/confidence. Explain thin markets and possible manipulation.

tools.name: craft_plan
tools.description: Select craft/DE chains under a capital budget. Include expected profit, risk capital and assumptions.

tools.name: profession_advice
tools.description: Suggest professions based on priced coverage and profitable chains.

tools.name: farming_plan
tools.description: Suggest farming zones/resources with nodes, score, value and limitations.

tools.name: explain
tools.description: Explain a recommendation formula and its assumptions; never claim guaranteed profit.

guardrails: flag thin markets and stale scans
never suggest automation, input injection or anti-cheat evasion
local-only by default; do not upload personal data
